'''Paul Motz Chicago Hunt Down''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Paul Motz]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-1819">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/1819 Chicago Hunt Down], DeckTech (Paul "Vollerian" Motz, 23 December 1999). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/1819/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/1819/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018215754/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/1819/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Paul Motz]]
* '''Published:''' 23 December 1999 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Chicago Hunt Down''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]

== Original post ==

'''Chicago Hunt Down'''
* '''Author:''' Paul "Vollerian" Motz
* '''Published:''' December 23, 1999
* '''Rating:''' 3.5
* '''Description:''' Another Variation of the Ever Popular Hunt Down and Destroy The Jedi, with a small twist of midwest flare.

=== Strategy ===

This deck is quite self explanatory.  Mass Force Drain while sucking them dry with the Visage.  Depending on what they are playing, choose an effect with the Twi'lek that will best help you.  Force drain and beat them down.  Any questions?
